chapter_title: Concerning the Five Things that he constructed with the hard Bodies of the Rulers
chapter_note: A short, systematic five-item construction list attributed to the Living Spirit. The only clear later layer is the formulaic dialogue/frame attribution in the opening clause of ¶1; the rest reads as impersonal cosmological-architectural instruction within the mythic system (no institutional application, exhortation, or NT overlay).

paragraphs.core_text: The Living Spirit constructed five great things from veins and skull[s in the] hard [bodies].
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the hagiographic/dialogue attribution formula: "Once again the enlightener speaks:" (late frame wrapper introducing the teaching).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Opening frame formula (“Once again… speaks”) marks the compiler’s hagiographic wrapper; the remaining sentence is impersonal cosmological exposition about the Living Spirit’s demiurgic construction within the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: The first is the disc that is placed upon [the sh]oulder of the Porter.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Numbered, schematic list item (1/5) describing cosmic architecture (disc/Porter) with no address, citation, or institutional reference—fits the old systematic teaching register.

paragraphs.core_text: The se[con]d are the arches of [the] pillar that is before him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the five-fold construction list in the same impersonal, architectural-cosmological mode; entirely internal to the cosmic scene (pillar/arches).

paragraphs.core_text: [The th]ird is the [mou]ld of the fo[r]m for the gehennas.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third item of the systematic list; remains within cosmological/eschatological mechanics (“gehennas”) rather than moral or institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth are the [seven (?)] pillars that he has erected in the great sea, in [the] seven parts of the universe.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Explicit cosmic geography (“great sea,” “seven parts of the universe”) and enumerative structure signal the teaching substrate; no seam into church practice or polemic.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth are the four walls that surround the vessels.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fifth item concludes the structured construction catalogue; cosmological-architectural description (“walls… vessels”) with no later framing or application voice.
